WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.sales_line_id, w.status,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered','collected')))
SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) buyers, count(*) n_lines, sum(net_amount) net_before_returns, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) web_net
FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19)
SELECT count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines_no_order_row
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.status='cancelled' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
cand AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-05-24'),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date
  FROM cand f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered','collected')))
SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) buyers, count(*) n_lines, sum(net_amount) net_before_returns, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) web_net
FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19)
SELECT count(*) return_lines, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) members, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key
JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19)
SELECT count(*) lines, sum(net_amount) net_by_sale_date_all_channels_incl_cancelled_unfiltered
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id=m.member_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 19),
targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key JOIN camp ON camp.campaign_id = e.campaign_id),
cand AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-05-24'),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date
  FROM cand f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered','collected')))
SELECT (SELECT campaign_name FROM camp) AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       ROUND((SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'), 2) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat
